sentence: From 2022-02-01 to 2026-11-02 (239 weekly decisions, both traded at the open), labels set with the pre-market price returned +27.1% a year (worst drawdown -43.0%) against +25.5% (-40.1%) for labels set at the previous close; the two agreed on 87% of stock-weeks. Sharpe ratio difference +0.04 (95% block-bootstrap CI [-0.17, +0.22]): deciding before the open has been **not distinguishable from deciding on the previous close**.
